definitionZh: 口罩-mode CSS属性设定在被遮盖的元素上. 它设定了由面具-图像定义的面具引用是被作为亮度还是α面罩处理.
sourceDefinition: The mask-mode CSS property is set on the element being masked. It sets whether the mask reference defined by the mask-image is treated as a luminance or alpha mask.
